cand.title: Circle by Meliá Golf Challenge Punta Cana 2027
cand.excerpt: Rank 5: seven-night golf/incentive package naming Paradisus.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: David Villar, Summum CEO/founder, is also named with a direct email in the edition-specific 2027 operational team: strongest organizer relationship route. Fran Martos is verified as Summum business development and is relevant to future supplier/partnership discussion, but not verified as a 2027 buyer. Arjan ten Have is an edition-specific Meliá team contact with a current golf/business-development profile: relevant to understanding chain involvement, not an independent hotel buyer. No source establishes any individual’s hotel-contract signing authority.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming seven-night programme, 19–26 February 2027 in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic, within the requested horizon. These are activity dates, not publication dates. Arrival is 19 February, golf competition 21, 22, 24 and 25 February, departure 26 February. The brochure calls this the sixth edition.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied Wyndham Alltra profile: a seven-night all-inclusive golf/leisure group is a more natural product fit than a large conference. Guestroom-led stays, accompanying guests and social dinners are directionally compatible with this resort; the modest meeting space need not be the principal constraint. Actual banquet layout, transport to four courses, tee-time access, premium-service expectations and pricing require assessment. A Punta Espada golf day does not relocate the hotel stay to Cap Cana or imply available demand there.
findings.venueCommitments: Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort is the announced official hotel and seven-night all-inclusive accommodation included in the 2027 package, not merely a preferred-hotel listing. This establishes a published accommodation/host commitment; it does not disclose an executed contract, guaranteed block size, pickup, exclusivity or release terms. Golf venues are Cocotal, La Cana, Punta Espada and Corales. The member programme independently names Paradisus Palma Real for the same dates. No specific hotel function room is identified.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified sequence: Punta Cana 2022, Punta Cana 2023, Punta Cana 2024, Dubai 2025, Riviera Maya/Playa del Carmen 2026, then Punta Cana 2027. This is demonstrated recurrence with destination changes, not proof of a fixed rotation or a confirmed 2028 edition. Hotel evidence remains within the Meliá family. For 2024, the advertised seven-night lodging was Meliá Punta Cana Beach; the post-event report places the closing dinner at Paradisus Palma Real. These are distinct roles, not interchangeable lodging evidence.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Summum sells the event package directly: seven nights all-inclusive in a shared double at Paradisus Palma Real; single-use supplement is advertised. Registration is through hola@summumgolf.com and the announcement requires 50% payment to formalize a reservation. Participant enrollment being open does not mean hotel procurement is open. For sales screening, 2027 lodging is committed elsewhere; any residual/additional sourcing is unknown. No public hotel RFP, room-block quantity, overflow instruction or named external DMC was identified.
findings.organizationStructure: Commercial golf-event/travel organizer, not an association congress. Summum is the stated organizer; Meliá, Club Meliá and Summum jointly appear on the 2027 contact team. Summum records Meliá becoming principal Top10 sponsor and acquiring Meliá Rewards naming in 2022. Circle by Meliá also distributes the 2027 event to members. Legal ownership and contracting entity for this edition are not established; neither Paradisus nor the golf courses should be substituted for the organizer.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The competing incumbent is Paradisus Palma Real in Bávaro, explicitly packaged for the future edition. Meliá/Circle branding, member distribution and the documented Meliá sponsor relationship create a structural competitive barrier, not just a venue-price comparison (inference). Destination rotation alone does not establish openness to a non-Meliá hotel. No sourced evidence of sellout, overflow, displaced rooms or dissatisfaction was found; do not create an overflow opportunity.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach David Villar through his published event email, copying or requesting an introduction to Fran Martos for business development. Acknowledge the 2027 Paradisus commitment; ask whether Summum has independently sourced Punta Cana golf/incentive groups eligible for Wyndham, who chooses lodging, and when the next relevant sourcing window occurs. Offer a concise all-inclusive stay-and-play concept with course-transfer/logistics questions rather than an unsolicited 2027 replacement quote. Seek additional rooms only if the organizer confirms an unmet need.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the upcoming February 2027 edition, the principal hotel stay is announced at Paradisus; do not classify it as open hotel sourcing. The invitation to register and limited participant places are enrollment signals, not a request for alternative accommodation. Uncontracted supplementary rooms, if any, remain unknown.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Conditional relationship-development opportunity only (inference). Multiple destinations and editions support recurrence, but the reviewed sources do not announce a 2028 edition or establish non-Meliá eligibility. Summum’s wider corporate/event portfolio offers a more plausible exploratory route than assuming displacement of a chain-branded flagship. Any later Punta Cana proposal must first establish brand flexibility and real lodging procurement needs.
